svg.aria-label: Client (in focus): Creates and follows links. Load balancer (in focus): Distributes requests. API servers (in focus): Shortener API and redirect. Cache (context): Holds active mappings. Link store (context): Durable code mappings. Replicas (context): Copies across zones. ID allocator (context): Reserves unique ID blocks. Hash candidate (context): Truncated URL hash. Click queue (context): Buffers redirect events. Count store (context): Aggregated clicks. Rate limiter (added) (in focus): Limits link creation. Limit creates by account. Safety checks (added) (in focus): Validate destinations. Support disable and expiry. Flow: Client to Load balancer: Submit a long URL. Load balancer to Rate limiter: Check create limit. Rate limiter to API servers: Forward create. API servers to Safety checks: Check destination.
